text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the existing parking prohibition on the east side of Blantyre Avenue, north of Queen Street East, be increased to a standing prohibition. The proposed amendment will further deter parking on this section of Blantyre Avenue which will improve unobstructed two-way traffic flow, providing a safer environment for all road users.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on both sides of Blantyre Avenue, between Queen Street and a point 46 metres north of Queen Street to be in effect on the west side of Blantyre Avenue between Queen Street East and a point 46 metres north. 2. Prohibited standing at all times on east side of Blantyre Avenue, between Queen Street East and a point 46 metres north.
